# relay

> An open-source harness that turns one person's coding-agent subscriptions (Claude, Codex, Grok) into one system: GitHub issues as the task bus, self-hosted runners on your own machines, shared memory in Postgres, and an event feed of everything agents did. Credentials never leave the machine they were created on. Free, Apache-2.0.

## Start here

- [What relay is](https://harness.kyro.house/info): the five rules, how a task flows, quick install, linking model accounts
- [Feed](https://harness.kyro.house/): every issue, run, model call, PR, review and deployment, newest first
- [AGENTS.md](https://harness.kyro.house/docs/agents): instructions for coding agents working in or installing relay
- [README](https://harness.kyro.house/docs/readme): what it does, quick install, how to link model accounts

## Guides

- [Architecture](https://harness.kyro.house/docs/architecture): the design and the rules behind it
- [API and MCP](https://harness.kyro.house/docs/api): the read API under /api/v1, rate limits, scopes, and the MCP server at /mcp
- [Versioning and deprecation](https://harness.kyro.house/docs/versioning): how the API changes and the RFC 9745 headers used when something is retired
- [Agent readiness](https://harness.kyro.house/docs/agent-readiness): what the hosted site serves so agents can find, read, and use it

## Machine-readable

- [OpenAPI](https://harness.kyro.house/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of /api/v1
- [API catalog](https://harness.kyro.house/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset
- [MCP server card](https://harness.kyro.house/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): tools and transport for /mcp
- [Agent skills](https://harness.kyro.house/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): the relay install skill
- [AI catalog](https://harness.kyro.house/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): site catalog for agents
- [Full docs](https://harness.kyro.house/llms-full.txt): everything above concatenated
